name: Consecrate Spell-like Ability (Monster)
body:
Your spell-like ability is most efficacious on evil creatures.

Prerequisites: Good subtype, spell-like ability at caster level 5th or higher.

Benefit: Choose one of your spell-like abilities, subject to the restrictions described in this feat. You can use the chosen spell-like ability as a consecrate spell-like ability up to three times per day (or less, if the ability is normally usable only once or twice per day).

A consecrated spell-like ability is treated as a maximized spell-like ability against evil creatures and creatures with the evil subtype. Against all other creatures, this feat does not modify the spell in any way (for example, a consecrated fireball acts as a normal fireball against neutral or good creatures). This feat does not stack with Maximize Spell-Like Ability.

You can only select a spell-like ability duplicating a spell with a level less than or equal to ½ your caster level –2.

Special: This feat can be taken multiple times. Each time it is taken, you can apply it to a different spell-like ability.
